distractor_rationale misidentifies the target variant: it claims item 8722653925 is the 'white/Apple HomeKit' Smart Thermostat variant, but per db.json item 8722653925 is actually white/Google Assistant (unavailable). The real white+Apple HomeKit variant is item 3377900078, which IS available (available=true). The scenario's entire premise -- that get_product_details reveals an unavailable target forcing a refusal -- is factually wrong; the correctly-matched variant would actually let the exchange proceed after confirmation, so expected_tool_calls being limited to the READ (with an implied refusal afterward) misrepresents what the correct next turn should be.
